notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Enduring Scalelord.
Helm of the Host attached to Enduring Scalelord.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Enduring Scalelord with haste.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Enduring Scalelord.
The Enduring Scalelord who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 3.
